text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple organized paragraphs with \"First,\" \"Second,\" \"My first reason,\" and a conclusion","quality":"text organization","description":"The essay shows clearer overall structure and paragraphing that help the reader follow its progression of ideas."},{"evidence":"repeated expansion of reasons with added details about animals, medicine, and work tasks","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay elaborates its points more fully instead of relying on a few brief examples."},{"evidence":"\"I want to learn new things\"; \"I want to see what they do\"; \"what happens when a animals get sick\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay builds on its main claims with supporting details that make the reasons more substantial."},{"evidence":"\"how is it like to work at the zoo\"; \"I want to learn how you treat the animals\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay has somewhat stronger command of sentence framing even though it still contains errors and awkward wording."},{"evidence":"more sustained focus on one topic across the response","quality":"topic consistency","description":"The essay stays more consistently centered on its chosen subject without shifting into unrelated scenarios."}]}
